### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/spec-changes.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/declarative-endpoints.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/api (route, a path literal in reason; a path literal in semantic))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/spec-changes.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0bbe4005e82fce2058238720cac7ba5cd2f182d5` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0a2f5204d77f747d04b739fc213b9dc5f1fe2c54` — the merge of head `d24a253bd04582f05875143dee32077168bdd193` into base `0bbe4005e82fce2058238720cac7ba5cd2f182d5`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0a2f5204d77f747d04b739fc213b9dc5f1fe2c54 && git checkout 0a2f5204d77f747d04b739fc213b9dc5f1fe2c54
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0bbe4005e82fce2058238720cac7ba5cd2f182d5 d24a253bd04582f05875143dee32077168bdd193 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0bbe4005e82fce2058238720cac7ba5cd2f182d5 && git merge --no-ff d24a253bd04582f05875143dee32077168bdd193

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0bbe4005e82fce2058238720cac7ba5cd2f182d5
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0bbe4005e82fce2058238720cac7ba5cd2f182d5` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d24a253bd04582f05875143dee32077168bdd193`
Local-runs: none

Head unmoved across the review (re-read at the end: same sha, `open`, draft, `mergeable_state: clean`). Merge base `9e9bb464` (the stage-4 squash); `origin/main` is `0bbe4005`, one commit past it (the landed #20511: a `qa-` entry, a retired key, `registry.ts`). Inputs: card #20233 (body + all 19 comments), PR #20522 (body, 30-file list, net diff against `main`), the head's check-runs. Read-only throughout: `git archive` extracts of base and head parsed by my own AST and tokenising instruments; nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments
1. **Text only — holds, mechanically.** For each of the 25 entry files, base vs head parsed and compared: every import declaration identical; every `//` / `/* */` comment token identical; every property other than `reason` / `replacement` / `acceptanceCriteria` identical by evaluated value (`id`, `from` / `to`, every matcher); the code skeleton with joined-string runs collapsed identical; the property-key sequence identical. **25 files compared, 0 with a non-prose change.** Only the prose fields' evaluated values differ (`reason` in 25, `acceptanceCriteria` in 2, `replacement` in 6). The one allowed `surface` move is `18.dataset-measure-aggregate-field-type-refused` (base carried `#16099` and `#17560`, head carries none) — the instrument's only note, so ruling A `5858839916` had exactly one site here. The instrument fails first on an in-memory copy: DETECTED for a mutated `id`, a mutated comment, a mutated `surface` whose base carried no tracker id, a mutated code token and a mutated import; dark on a prose-only edit and on a re-split string run. The 25 files are exactly the PR's entry files; the seven entries of these families that carried no number (`api-endpoint-cache-ttl-unit-in-key`, `field-inline-and-related-list-columns-closed`, `field-master-detail-set-null-refused`, `field-reference-to-spelling-retired`, `hook-timeout-unit-in-key`, `metadata-changed-event-payload-retired`, `metadata-item-name-grammar-enforced`) read 0 on base and are absent from the file list; no entry file outside the 25 differs; no `rest-`, `qa-`, `turso-`, `stack-`, `cube-` or `data__` file is touched. A head-prose scan of the six families for `issue` / `card` / `PR` / `batch` / `record` / `summon` / `item` + number, `objectui#` / `framework#` / `cloud#`, and any run of six or more digits finds nothing (base carried `PR #5279`, `PR #5203`, `PR #6532` ×2, `PR #5049`, `PR #11989`, `Card #20078`, seven `batch #NNN` and two `record NNNNNNNNNN` spellings, all gone). So none of #20234's comment lines moved (823 comment lines with a tracker id on both sides), and no entry's identity or matching moved.
2. **Truth of the rewrites — holds; no lesson lost, softened or overstated.** Read against single REST reads of all 75 cited ids (71 bare incl. the `framework#3956` spelling, 3 `objectui#`; 4 answer 404 on the issues endpoint, `6148`, `6573`, `13135`, `11513`, the same four the dev names; nothing else is dead), the ruling-record comments by id, and `main`'s own files:
   - `17.api-runtime-create-withdrawn` (9): `#5488`'s ruling `5219848313` (maintainer 2026-08-07, Option B: flip `api` to `allowRuntimeCreate: false`, refuse at the write inlet; zero pull, Option 1 re-opens cache / invalidation / tenancy / ADR-0110 on a new read path; re-entry "if #2657 Part B ever promotes `apis` to a registered type with a real consumption path — implementation first") — every clause was already in the sentence, the id is dropped; `#5311` (the `saveMetaItem` direct-active write, "a third path past the namespace gate (ADR-0121) and the duplicate gate", closed the same second as subsumed) → "the same refusal closes the direct-active write too, which had been a third path past the endpoint namespace and duplicate-path gates" TRUE; `#2657` (Studio metadata coverage gaps, Part B promotes un-typed concepts, `apis` among them) → "the Studio metadata-coverage work" TRUE; `#5040 E8 LIVE` (the executor project's acceptance: showcase endpoints restored and probed live on a real boot) → "showcase uses the artifact route, and its declared endpoints serve live" TRUE; `#4052`, `#5279`, `#5189`, `#5203` named by the key / functions the sentence already carried.
   - `17.field-runtime-create-withdrawn` (9): `#7893` (the ruled retirement of the runtime `field` write, 2026-08-13), `#7743` (the field overlay lock, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`), `#7894` (`PUT /meta/fields/…` walked around the two-tier gate; folded onto the singular), `#8169` ("the envelope has no 'in effect' axis", the card's own title) — each named by its surface, every prescription kept.
   - `17.export-field-meta-constraints-retired` (8): `framework#3956` (title: "Import dry-run skips field-level validation") → "added when the dry run was found skipping the field-level validation the real write ran" TRUE; `#4633` ruling `5202274606` / `5203550406` (maintainer 2026-08-06, D: a validate-only protocol operation, "prediction = verdict by construction", the hand-copied mirror retired) → TRUE verbatim in substance; `#6536` (PR #6532 "kept for now rather than removed in the same PR … a separable change with its own sweep") → "the removal the dry-run change deliberately deferred to a sweep of its own" TRUE; `#4484` / `#5540` / `#6011` named by surface.
   - `17.hook-register-empty-object-target-refused` (8): PR `#4281` (`fix(spec,objectql)!`: an empty hook target is no longer amplified into a wildcard) → "An earlier breaking fix established that an empty hook target is not 'no target'" TRUE; `#5928` (title: the contract could not say "global but exclude these objects") → "the later `excludeObjects` face (a hook global except for the objects it names)" TRUE, and "declined to do it in passing" is `engine.ts:2111-2117` on `main` ("keeps the TRUTHINESS test both copies used verbatim … that read is deliberately UNCHANGED"); `#6573` (404) is this entry's own change (`packages/objectql/CHANGELOG.md:5949`, `engine.ts:2198` / `:2252`), trailing id dropped; `#4001` → ADR-0078 kept.
   - `18.field-max-length-malformed-or-misplaced-refused` (8): `#11566` ruling `5393505555` (maintainer 2026-08-24, "tighten both halves": `z.number().int().min(1)` and applicability to the validator's ten types) → "tightening both halves — the value's shape and the types the key applies to" TRUE; `#11875` (maintainer 2026-08-25, option 1: give the write seam a bound, then `signature` / `qrcode` join the bounded set — confirmed on #11949 `5408644743`) → "which joined once the write seam enforced a declared bound on them" TRUE; `#11431` (its record: "a malformed bound is no longer read as authoritative — `maxLength: 0` had been planning a destructive `varchar(0)`") → TRUE, near-verbatim; `#8321` → "the house pattern the `precision`/`scale` integer refusal set" TRUE; `#11989` / `#11950` dropped as provenance, "shipped on the 17.x line … registration was deferred to a follow-up" kept.
   - `17.export-axis-opt-in` (7): `#6350` (title: #6148's gate judges only the diff, the v17 train's 227 breaking changesets were never compared) → "the stock reconciliation that compared the breaking changesets already on the v17 release train against this ledger" TRUE; `#3544` / `#3710` (the user-level export axis; scheduled reports' CSV attachments as its second door) → TRUE; `#6148` (404) → `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:4-5` "a PR that DECLARES a breaking change must state, in writing, what it did about the ADR-0087 migration ledger" → "the gate that makes a breaking changeset state its ADR-0087 disposition" TRUE.
   - `18.export-job-family-retired` (6): `#17158` ruling A `5644350616` (batch #122 item 3, 2026-09-12: retire the family, `IExportService` and `ScheduleExportInput`; `ScheduleState` with it unless a live consumer is measured), landing route A `5815151991` (batch #221 item 2, 2026-09-24: objectui#10247 retires the unimplemented async-export path first, then this card), scope note `5825830323` (2026-09-25, 「同意」: #19543's door ② absorbed — the export-job list's declared `limit` / `cursor` no reader spends) — the head sentence states all three with their dates, TRUE; `#19543` (title: three sibling list doors declare `limit` / `cursor` and never read them) TRUE; `#16320` (retire the seven cron-typed positions nothing reads) → "the retirement of the cron-typed positions nothing read" TRUE.
   - `17.hook-context-session-roles-retired` (6): `#4839` / PR `#5049` (title: the two `session.roles` admin exemptions deleted — record lock and delegation guard back to one permission vocabulary) → TRUE verbatim in substance; `#3733` (its comment `5098751722`, 2026-07-28: `FieldSchema` is not `.strict()`, so the removed `cached` key "parses successfully and is silently dropped") → "as a removed field key was measured to be" TRUE; `#4579` / `#4657` by surface; `#5050` this entry's own card.
   - `18.dataset-measure-aggregate-field-type-refused` (5 + `surface` 2) and `-selecting-` (5): the director's batch #59 ruling `5560090715` on #16099 (2026-09-06, headed "both legs, table in spec", rows verbatim 「`min`/`max` numeric plus `date`/`datetime`; everything else refused」) → both kept quotes are that record's own words, framed as its ruling, TRUE; `#17560` ruling `5651572190` (batch #127 item 3, 2026-09-13, B: the compile door enforces the table for every aggregate; "the ruled C prose in the tree has no ruling behind it") → "Director ruling B of 2026-09-13: the compile door enforces the table for every aggregate" TRUE; `#17513` closed `duplicate` with one comment (the triage fold) and zero rulings → TRUE; `#16099` (PR #17559 re-cut the door to `sum` / `avg` over every field type) → "followed in a later change" TRUE; `#16353`, `#16737`, `#15768`, `#16236` named by the table or already stated.
   - `18.dataset-filter-nested-relation-equality-array-refused-at-save` (2 + 2 record ids): `5805248669` (ruling A on #19889, 2026-09-24: "the schema door refuses what the compile face refuses") and `5825670610` (triage on #20080, 2026-09-25: remedy A on the two analytics carriers; B "changes what a nested list means and would need a ruling") → both sentences TRUE, dates and content carried, the record ids gone.
   - `18.metadata-*` (16): `#15542` / `#15854` ruling `5557095147` (2026-09-06, 2 + A, "one principle across both sibling cards: an `endpoints.*` switch gates exactly the face its name states, reads and writes alike"; the whole-store family gets `maintenance`) → "The maintainer ruled the two together on 2026-09-06 as one principle" TRUE; `#15543` by its title; `#8586` / `#8421` ruling `5293094846` (maintainer 2026-08-14, 「同意」 to "#8586 remove + #8421 refuse by static registry (联裁)") → "remove the key, jointly with refusing unknown types at the `/meta` boundary by the static registry" TRUE; `#4212` (four of five lifecycle hooks never invoked; the docs tell plugins to use one) → "the plugin lifecycle's `onInstall` (a documented hook with no invocation site)" TRUE; `#15624` (triage 2026-09-05, ADR-0049 retirement; the spec seat's hold note "re-read on the merged ref") → "the owning seat's ruling, conditioned on the measurement below and re-taken on the merged ref", a provenance paraphrase, no decision moved; `#12057` answers 200 but carries only its triage comment — `packages/metadata/CHANGELOG.md:714-715` records "the maintainer adopted retirement on #12057 (2026-08-29, 「同意」), and #13135 charters the full coupling set the fork report measured" → the head sentence says exactly that (the "rejected a re-scope" half is the base's own framing of the card's two offered dispositions, unchanged); `#13135` (404) → the same CHANGELOG line, TRUE; `#11513` (404) → ADR-0126:28-29 "the #11513 lock-and-clone ruling (2026-08-24 …)", §9 "Explicitly not chartered: the ServiceNow-style overlay layer … deferred again here" → "the 2026-08-24 lock-and-clone ruling (lock the packaged base, customize a clone) left deliberately unchartered" TRUE.
   - `18.api-assembled-entry-split`: `#18576` ruling `5714238181` (batch #145 item 1, 2026-09-17, B: narrow the `./api` entry; A a weight rule on the ledger; C accept the weight) → TRUE with the 「同意,其他也同意」 replaced by the date and content. `18.field-currency-scale-refused`: records `5791803339` (batch #215 item 1, B, 2026-09-23, retire `scale` from `currency`) and `5805782503` (batch #218 item 2, 乙, 2026-09-24, "a currency's decimal places are the currency's, not a setting") → both dates and both letters TRUE. `18.field-min-length`: `#11949` ruling `5406812991` (2026-08-25, B, `min(1)`, the #11566 template in full) TRUE. `18.field-multiple-non-capable-type-refused`: `#17469` ruling `5651739207` (batch #128 item 5, 2026-09-13, 1′, "the #11437 radio rule generalised") TRUE; objectui#8886 ("the arity verdict is the spec's, not a local copy") and objectui#8937 ("is owed and was not filed") TRUE. `18.field-predicate-reference-traversal-refused`: `5825661201` (triage 2026-09-25, remedy A: refuse at authoring with a prescription; B a capability of its own) TRUE; `#18682` "one hop" TRUE. `18.field-scale-precision-integer-refused`: `#7501` ("an over-scale write is REFUSED, never rounded", as `5791803339` itself restates it) TRUE. `18.hook-register-undispatched-lifecycle-event-refused`: `#3195` (collapse 18 → 8; "registration guard: warn when a hook subscribes to an event the engine never dispatches") TRUE; `#17713` its own card.
   - `18.api-error-retry-after-unit-in-key` / `18.api-runtime-config-durations-unit-in-key` / `18.metadata-manager-config-*` (`#14478`, `#15677`): "Maintainer ruling B of 2026-09-02 on duration-shaped keys: the unit lives in the key NAME or in a unit-carrying value … no existing offender is grandfathered" is ruling B `5518649320` (the maintainer's 2026-09-02 reply, recorded 2026-09-03; "no grandfathered baseline" is its own headline) — TRUE. **One date nit, content intact:** the retryAfter entry's next clause, "the ruling puts the ~16 runtime-emitted measurements in scope … and names `ApiError.retryAfter` explicitly, with its own BREAKING note", is the population ruling `5548763981` (decision batch #43, 2026-09-05, also B, also the maintainer's). The base fused the two as "(2026-09-02, decision batch #43)"; the head drops the batch marker and keeps the first date, so that clause now reads under 2026-09-02. Nothing was invented, weakened or strengthened — stage 3 resolved the same fusion by naming both dates. Recorded in ③.
   - **The dropped numbers.** Eleven decision-batch numbers (`#43` ×2, `#59` ×2, `#122`, `#127`, `#128`, `#145`, `#215`, `#218`, `#221`) and five ruling-record ids (the two currency records, `5825661201`, `5805248669`, `5825670610`) each give way to the ruling's date and content above; the five acknowledgements (「同意,其他也同意」 on `#18576`, 「同意」 ×3 on `#17158`'s three records, 「同意」 on `#12057`) likewise. The three kept `Prime Directive #12` / `PD #12` spellings name AGENTS.md's rule 12 ("Contract-first — fix the metadata, not the runtime", `AGENTS.md:172` ff. on `main`), the rule those sentences invoke; stages 2–4 kept `Prime Directive #10` / `PD #10` in `ui-`, `plugin-`, `identity-`, `package-` entries the same way, and the pin's `TRACKER_ID` is `#\d{4,5}\b` by design.
3. **Census — reproduced exactly with my own instrument** (AST over every file under `entries/`, string runs under the three keys, `#\d{4,5}\b`; `surface` apart; comment tokens apart; 747 files, 311 semantic entries, 0 unevaluable). Base `9e9bb464`: whole tree **571** (36/503/32), `surface` 7, short 61, comment lines 823; `field-` 10 entries / 28 (5/20/3, 20 distinct), `export-` 3 / 21 (0/21/0, 15), `hook-` 4 / 17 (0/17/0, 12), `api-` 5 / 16 (0/14/2, 11), `metadata-` 7 / 16 (1/15/0, 11), `dataset-` 3 / 12 (2/8/2, 9) + 2 `surface` = **110** (8/95/7) in **24 of 32** entries, **75** distinct tokens (71 bare, `framework#3956`, 3 `objectui#`), short 14, cross-repo spellings 5, word+number spellings 16. Head: all six families **0**, `surface` 0, short 3 (the `#12`s), cross-repo 0, word+number 0; the eleven earlier families still 0; whole tree **461** (28/408/25), `surface` **5**, short **50**, comment lines **823**. Lit control `17.aggregation-node-distinct-retired` 7 (1/6/0) both sides. On `origin/main` `0bbe4005` the tree reads 571 / 7 / 825 comment lines (the new `qa-` entry's two), as the dev reports for the merged tree. Nothing the three fields carry was missed, cross-repo and "issue NNNN" spellings included.
4. **Pin — widened, not weakened.** `COVERED_PREFIXES` 11 → 17 (`field-`, `export-`, `api-`, `dataset-`, `hook-`, `metadata-`); the match is `s.id.startsWith(prefix)` over `step.semantic` (`:215`), so `data-` selects neither `datasource-` nor `dataset-`, `api-` does not select `apimethod-`, and PR #20512's retired-key file `18.api__RestApiConfig__documentation.version.ts` (no id, not semantic) is not selected. **No `rest-` prefix entered** (0 occurrences). `REWRITTEN` 88 → **113**, and the 25 added ids are exactly the 25 changed entries (set-diffed), `field-currency-scale-refused` included as the one that carried only batch and record numbers. The diff's only lines outside the header comment and the two lists is the one `COVERED_PREFIXES` line; the three `it` blocks (`:274` detector self-test, `:282` every-prefix-non-empty + `REWRITTEN` containment, `:290` verbatim-block-in-stdout + `TRACKER_ID` absent) and every `expect` are textually identical. No other test moved: on `main`, no `toMatch` / `toContain` / `toBe` assertion cites any of the 75 removed numbers except the three `#5040` runtime-hint assertions (#20513's family, ③), and the only test naming one of the 25 ids, `export-job-family-retirement.test.ts:91`, asserts the public surface, not the prose.

7. **Changeset — every sentence true.** `'@objectstack/spec': patch`; `Clause-②: no` on its own line; "some of which no longer resolve" (four 404s), "some in another repository" (`objectui#`, `framework#`), "ADR ids are kept", "Text only: no entry id, `from` / `to`, conversion or matching logic changes", "One entry's `surface` … drops the two tracker numbers it carried and names nothing else differently" (the only other wording change there is "under #16099" → "in a later change"), "the generated … carry the same text" — all verified above.

### ② Semver level
`patch` is correct: no accept set moves, no export, key or matcher changes; only the author-shown guidance text of 25 entries, their three generated projections, a widened queue-tier pin and a changeset. `Clause-②: no` with no arm is the well-formed declaration: no new authorable key, no accept-set narrowing or widening, so no Clause-② review is owed beyond this at-tier record. Check Changeset and Lint & Repo Gates (`check:changeset-no-major`, `check:adr-0087-registration`) are green on the head. The two commits' trailers carry no model identifier.
